title: Greensleeves
composition: traditional English ballad, 16th century; public domain
credit: Performed by La Juglaresa (Emilio Villalba); the recording is CC BY 3.0 on Wikimedia Commons, so the credit is part of the licence.
lyrics: Alas, my love, you do me wrong
For I have loved you well and long
Greensleeves was my heart of gold
And who but my lady Greensleeves
